items.text: THEY ARE WARY, BUT NOT HOSTILE.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: STANDING READY THEIR LEADER SAYS 'YOU MUST BE THE SERVANTS OF YARASH!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a distinct same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: THEIR LEADER SAYS 'FOUL SERVANTS OF YARASH!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a distinct same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: THEY RECOIL IN FEAR
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THERE IS NOWHERE LEFT TO RETREAT. YOU MUST FIGHT.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THIS DIRECTION WILL TAKE YOU BACK INTO THE WILDERNESS. DO YOU STILL WANT TO GO THIS WAY?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration ending with a direct question

items.text: YOU TRIP ON A WIRE TO THE ACCOMPANIMENT OF BELLS TINKLING. AFTER A MOMENT THERE IS A COMMOTION AHEAD OF YOU.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU CHARGE INTO A GROUP OF SCRUFFY LOOKING NOMADS.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: A GROUP OF NOMADS SPOT YOU. THEY SHOUT AND CHARGE. AS THEY COME CLOSER THEIR NUMBERS SWELL WITH ARRIVALS.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: THE HEROIC DEATHS OF THOSE YOU HAVE JUST BATTLED HAS BOUGHT TIME FOR THE HEADMAN TO RALLY HIS PEOPLE. WITH A TREMENDOUS CRY HE LEADS HIS TRIBE INTO BATTLE.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE BIGGEST, MEANEST, DIRTIEST NOMAD PUSHES HIS WAY TO THE FRONT OF THE CROWD. FIVE OTHER NOMADS STAND AROUND HIM AS IF TO PROTECT HIM.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'THEN YOU MUST LEAVE US,' HE RESPONDS WITH AS MUCH DIGNITY AS HE CAN MUSTER. DO YOU LEAVE?
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a distinct same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'YOUR INSULTS ARE TOO MANY! KILL THEM!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a distinct same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: A GUARD APPEARS BEFORE YOU, 'YOU MUST HAVE MADE A MISTAKE. ALLOW ME TO ESCORT YOU TO YOUR LODGING.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a distinct same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: THE HEADMAN COMES TO YOU AND SAYS, 'ABOUT MY REQUEST OF LAST NIGHT, WHAT IS YOUR DECISION?'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a distinct same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: LOOKING DISAPPOINTED THE HEADMAN SAYS, 'GOOD LUCK IN YOUR TRAVELS.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a distinct same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'I AND MY PEOPLE THANK YOU. AND KNOW THAT WE HAVE HONOR. YOU SHALL BE RICHLY REWARDED FOR YOUR GENEROUS AID.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a distinct same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'YOU MAY WANDER AS YOU WILL OR YOU MAY STAY HERE AND REST AND STUDY. FORGIVE ME, I MUST SEE TO MY PEOPLE.' HE LEAVES.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a distinct same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: THE SOUND OF WAR CRIES DRAWS YOU OUT OF THE HUT.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: A HORDE OF KOBOLDS IS ATTACKING THE CAMP. A LONE SENTRY CHARGES BUT IS QUICKLY CUT DOWN. A FAMILY EMERGES FROM A HUT AND CHARGES THE KOBOLDS.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: AHEAD YOU SEE A LARGE GROUP OF KOBOLDS ENGAGED IN MELEE WITH SOME NOMADS.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE NOMADS SEE YOU AND SHOUT, 'THE FILTHY TRAITORS! GET THEM!' THE KOBOLDS, SEEING AN OPPORTUNITY, JOIN WITH THEM.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a distinct same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'THEN LET US DO IT!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a distinct same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: A HORDE OF KOBOLDS IS ATTACKING THE CAMP.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: ADVANCING ON YOU IS A LARGE BAND OF KOBOLDS WITH BLOOD LUST IN THEIR EYES.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU SEE A HUGE GROUP OF KOBOLDS MOVING RELUNCTANTLY FORWARD UNDER THE CURSES OF THEIR LEADER.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: JUST AS YOU THINK YOURSELVES FREE OF DANGER, THE HEADMAN, HIS SHAMAN AND GUARDS ATTACK WITH CRIES OF 'FOUL TRAITORS!' AT THE SAME TIME KOBOLDS ATTACK.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a distinct same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: AS YOU MOVE THROUGH THE ROOM THERE IS A FLASH, AND YOU SUDDENLY FIND YOURSELVES ELSEWHERE.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU SEE A HUMAN PRIEST.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: I HAVE A SECRET. I HAVE CHISELED ALMOST ALL THE WAY THROUGH TO THE OUTSIDE. BUT I NO LONGER HAVE THE STRENGTH TO BREAK THROUGH. WILL YOU TRY?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration ending with a direct question

items.text: YOU BREAK THROUGH. THE PRIEST TEARFULLY THANKS YOU AND GOES THROUGH THE HOLE.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THERE IS A HOLE IN THE WALL THAT LEADS TO THE OUTSIDE. DO YOU GO THROUGH IT?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration ending with a direct question

items.text: PEACE BROTHER. YOU, TOO, ARE ONE OF MY FLOCK. I HAVE BUT RECENTLY PRAYED FOR ANOTHER OF MY FLOCK AND MAY PRAY NO MORE.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU THROW A ROCK. SUDDENLY IT DISAPPEARS WITH A FLASH!
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS YOU MOVE THROUGH THE ROOM THERE IS A FLASH AND YOU SUDDENLY FIND YOURSELF ELSEWHERE.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU THROW A ROCK. SUDDENLY IT DISAPPEARS WITH A FLASH!
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU SEE A GROUP OF FIVE LIZARD MEN. THEY HISS AT YOU.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'SINCE YOU ARE NOT THE SERVANTS OF YARASH, WE WILL NOT KILL YOU. THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS NOT MY ENEMY!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a distinct same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'MUTILATING SCUM! WE WILL DIE BEFORE WE LET YOU TWIST US AS YOU HAVE OUR OTHER PEOPLE! BUT YOU WILL DIE FIRST!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a distinct same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU HAVE ENTERED A ROOM FILLED WITH A HORRIBLE ASSORTMENT OF TORTURE INSTUMENTS. IN THE CENTER IS A LARGE TABLE WITH METAL RESTRAINTS.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene
